description: Save a URL to the Wayback Machine for archival using the SPN2 API. Supports capturing screenshots, outlinks, and conditional archiving. Set WAYBACK_ACCESS_KEY and WAYBACK_SECRET_KEY env vars for higher SPN2 rate limits.

captureOutlinks.description: Also archive up to 100 outlink pages linked from this URL

captureScreenshot.description: Capture a screenshot of the page as a PNG image (uses the im_ modifier)

delayWbAvailability.description: Delay indexing ~12 hours to reduce server load

forceGet.description: Use simple HTTP GET instead of browser rendering (faster but no JS)

ifNotArchivedWithin.description: Skip if archived within timeframe, e.g. "30d" (30 days), "1h" (1 hour)

jsBehaviorTimeout.description: Run JavaScript for N seconds before capturing (max 30)

url.description: The URL to save to the Wayback Machine

name: save_url
